theater: Brazil Tropical Dynamics (Serra do Mar Landslides & Pantanal Flood Pulse)
compliance: Rule e2s-014 Certified (Zero Synthetic Noise, Authentic GFS Tensors, Explicit origin='upper')

br_sao_sebastiao.name: São Sebastião Coastal Escarpment
br_sao_sebastiao.significance: Steep coastal wall where record 683mm/24h orographic downpour triggered catastrophic debris flows, with slopes > 42° and complete radar decorrelation.

br_petropolis.name: Petrópolis Granitic Escarpment
br_petropolis.significance: Steep granitic amphitheatre slopes (> 45°) prone to lethal hyper-concentrated debris flows (Feb 2022 event, 250mm/3hr) with severe orographic delay gradients.

br_corumba_pantanal.name: Corumbá Upper Paraguay Wetland
br_corumba_pantanal.significance: Core Pantanal seasonal flood pulse corridor; vast specular reflection (sigma_0 VV < -16.5 dB) and extreme tropical ZTD (> 2.65m) across alluvial plains.

br_cuiaba_pantanal.name: Cuiabá River Wetland Basin
br_cuiaba_pantanal.significance: Northern Pantanal flood pulse entry basin; flat alluvial flats (< 0.5° slope) with expansive seasonal water inundation and high-moisture column.

br_sinop_arc.name: Sinop Deforestation Frontier
br_sinop_arc.significance: Amazon 'Arc of Deforestation' active clearing boundary; sharp radar backscatter contrast (-8 dB forest to -15 dB pasture) and high temporal decorrelation.

br_alta_floresta_frontier.name: Alta Floresta Teles Pires Basin
br_alta_floresta_frontier.significance: Frontier zone between primary Amazonian rainforest canopy and intensive agricultural pasture expansion, demonstrating rectilinear radar texture shifts.
